correctness.rationale: Direct Nyström multiplication gives Ahat=beta*wwT+e3e3T, beta=kappa/(kappa-(kappa-1)t)>1, and P=I+s*wwT with s=(kappa-1)t/((1+eta)*h). The 2x2 generalized eigenvalue polynomial has determinant ab-Sz+(1+s)z² and roots straddling b. Comparing root ratios reduces to S²-H²(1+s)=(s*(kappa-1)/(b*h))*G(t). Independent SymPy expansion returned zero for this polynomial identity, for the displayed G second derivative, and exact rational test P matrix and eigenvalue polynomial. Strict convexity plus endpoint G(0)>0,G(1)<0 yields unique crossing; continuity extends a witness to an open positive Gaussian probability set. Scope: rank-two sketch in dimension three, source-specific normalized preconditioner, exact arithmetic.
residual_risks: Independent bounded arithmetic confirms key identities where noted; numerical tests do not substitute for the infinite/continuous proof.

Frangella Proposition 5.3 bounds condition number by approximation error, which does not fix the sign relative to unpreconditioned a/b for a specified two-dimensional orientation.

value.rationale: A randomized preconditioner has probabilistic and approximation-error conditioning guarantees, but a per-realization claim that it always improves over no preconditioner is tempting and false. The sharp orientation transition, minimal-dimension witness and nonzero chance under standard Gaussian sketches provide a concrete motivated instability boundary for the actual normalized Nyström design.
residual_risks: Worsening spectral condition number does not prove slower PCG for each right-hand side.
No exact probability or general high-dimensional orientation classification.

final_claim: For one-spike SPD A=diag(kappa,1,1), eta>0 and rank-two Nyström sketch with t=kappa²u²/(kappa²u²+v²), exact condition number deterioration versus the unpreconditioned A+eta I holds iff G(t)=b*h*(a+b)*(1-2t)+t*(a-(kappa-1)*t)²>0, with exactly one interior threshold t*. A nonempty open sketch set (positive Gaussian probability) worsens conditioning for every kappa>1,eta>0.
